description: Daily calories for an adult to maintain weight, lose body fat or build muscle. Works out maintenance from age, sex, height, weight and how active a normal day is, not counting exercise, then the daily target and its range for the goal. Returns kcal a day, the range and a link to the method. Height (height_cm, or height_ft with height_in) and weight (weight_kg or weight_lb) are also required.

age.description: Age in years. The calculator is for adults; under 18 it says so instead of a number

day.description: A normal day, not counting exercise: seated (desk, driving), walking (errands, stairs, a commute on foot), on_feet (teaching, a shop, housework), physical (lifting, building, farm work)

goal.description: Optional. Without it, the answer is maintenance

height_ft.description: Height in feet, with height_in, instead of height_cm

height_in.description: The inches part of the height, 0 to 11

sex.description: female or male; the equations and reference values differ by sex

weight_lb.description: Weight in pounds, instead of weight_kg

name: calorie_calculator

inputs.description: The inputs as understood, in metric units

method.description: How the answer is worked out

note.description: A line instead of a number, when no number applies

title: Calorie calculator
